services.name: Campground page
services.desc: Come stay at the iconic Fairgrounds Campground in Langley, currently the only public campground on South Whidbey. Please review the Campground Rules and Regulations (updated 5/1/2026) prior to your stay. Stays are limited to 14 consecutive days/nights and all campers must acknowledge that they have reviewed, understand, and will comply with the Camping Rules and Regulations when paying for your campsite online here. Please fill out this form if you have any additional questions and someone will get back to you in a timely manner.
